text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Dreams"... Things like dreams
aren't sparkly and bright...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"‘Damn it all!’ ‘Just you watch!’
That's the fiery spirit I've run with all this time."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Yet right now... after burning through everything and running all the way to the end, this feeling is...!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: O-O-Ooooooooh...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: HELL YEAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross conquers the year-end Grand Prix!!
She is crowned Japan's number one for the year!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Trainer, I won!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to you... Thanks to you, I was able to become the real "White Lightning"!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Racing is... so much fun. It's so...
so fiercely hot, and feels so good.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't see it 'cause I was down at rock bottom.
Took a heck of a detour. But now—"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Breaking past rock bottom and plunging even deeper...
I finally made it. Right 'here.'"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oguri...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Are you thinking of quitting?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Showing me this run... are you thinking of quitting?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: What... what should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: From now on... I was supposed to get even stronger, even more amazing, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Does that mean I... can no longer run with you?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You came here chasing a dream...
Are you going to lose that dream now, Tama...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: When you're this energetic and wonderful...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Fine? ...Me?
Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
My body's... completely fine.
I gave it every ounce of my strength today.
Without a doubt, I poured everything I had into it.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it's still tingling, still burning hot...
Blazing with fire. This is—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"What'd you say?
Born again, you say...?"
choice_data_list: A lightning bolt running on pure craving

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Leaving it up to thirst...
I see. Because you keep me grounded,
I'm able to...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ye've grown tough enough to handle it, eh?
Even a match like this. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Hey, Creek! Get over here a sec!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, Tama-chan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Two Umamusume of the Classic Class stood side by side.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, you guys.
Your running still has a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: She's still in the Classic tier after all, and Creek was swerving quite a bit towards the end, too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If scatterbrains like them are the stars,
the race won't feel tight, and the fans won't be smilin' either.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So I'll come charging in with everything I've got! Next year, too! Straight from dead last on the far outside!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "So you don't end up crying like today, bring it on! Let's settle this again next year."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama...! Tama... thank you.
Yeah... I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I... I want to win too.
Against Tama-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
Tama... Tama... Ya done good...
You really did it...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text: Mom, can ya see her? This is my final act of filial piety. That's our girl out there—Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I can see her just fine...
She sure is a lively child, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's over, Rudolf.
The final great showdown,
bringing this wonderful year to a close.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was running so freely, wasn't that a great race?
The fans were thrilled too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap.
A bond equal to—or perhaps even greater than—ours...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Two titans clashing. Yet their true worth
surely does not end here.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh, what do you mean, you won't stay?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, can't you hear it, C.B.?
I can hear it. Yes, this is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Tamamo Cross stood
in the winner's circleâ

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
How's thaaat!? Did ya feel it, everyone!?
Did it send shivers right down your spine!?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Who is it? Who was talkin' big about how I was out of shape!? Well, take a good look at the results!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, but I'll let it slide.
I'm in a good mood today after all.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wahahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Bring it on, Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to this one being around this year, the
races were super exciting. Kept me fired up, too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Still! I ain't done yet, not by a long shot!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Next year! And in the years to come! I—we will be the ones leading this Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Bring on the next challengers!
Chapter Two of the White Lightning Legend begins now!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And thus, the White Lightning appears at the end of an era,
running forward into the next.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This time, not for a dream that 'must' be fulfilled,
but to seize a dream I 'want' to fulfill."
